topic: JavaScript DOM, Events, Forms, and Validation
learningObjectives: Manipulate DOM elements dynamically using JavaScript.
Handle user interactions through browser events.
Validate form inputs and provide appropriate feedback.

activities.title: DOM Tree Explorer
activities.instruction: Click each node to explore its relationship in the DOM tree.

content.concept: The DOM represents an HTML document as a hierarchical tree of nodes, where elements can contain child elements and can be accessed or modified with JavaScript.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: The root object representing the entire HTML document.
The root HTML element containing head and body.
Contains the visible content of the webpage.
Groups the primary content of the page.
An interactive element that can be selected and modified with JavaScript.

activities.title: Event Flow Builder
activities.instruction: Arrange the steps from a user action to a UI update.

content.concept: An event-driven interface responds to user actions by detecting an event, running a handler, and updating the DOM when necessary.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

goal: 4. Handler changes application or DOM data

activities.title: Validation Rule Selector
activities.instruction: Choose the validation rule that best fits each form field.

content.concept: Client-side validation checks whether submitted values satisfy rules such as required fields, valid email formats, minimum lengths, and numeric ranges before sending data to the server.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Email field → require a valid email format
Email field → require a minimum numeric value
config.answer: Email field → require a valid email format

activities.title: Interactive Form Builder
activities.instruction: Build a form flow using inputs, an event handler, validation, and feedback.

content.concept: An interactive form combines input elements with event handling, validation logic, and DOM updates to provide immediate feedback to users.
